title: T8 Bind model-index validation to the catalog snapshot and regenerate
description: Require exact catalog timestamp identity at generation and standalone validation, then regenerate only model-index.json after T7 and T9 correctness work.
action: Change validateModelIndex(index, catalog) to require exact index.catalogGeneratedAt === catalog.generatedAt while retaining all existing schema, board-reference, score, coverage, and open-weight validation. Generation passes catalog before writing; standalone validation loads optional index path then optional catalog path defaulting to data/models.json. Keep package and workflow commands unchanged.
implementation: Add exact-match, one-character mismatch, missing catalog/generatedAt, malformed board-reference, and pipeline snapshot tests after source changes.
Demonstrate pre-regeneration npm run validate:index rejects catalog 2026-07-29T10:58:23.602Z versus index 2026-07-28T11:37:25.935Z.
After TASK-007 and TASK-009, run npm run generate:index exactly once to regenerate only data/model-index.json from data/models.json; never hand-edit records.

Run standalone validation and focused data tests, then inspect generated evidence for corrected E1-E3 mappings, gpt-5 effort maximum scores, and retained schema/revision/source/unmatched/openWeights fields.
convergence_criteria: A one-character generatedAt mismatch returns a validation error and exact equality passes when all other index facts are valid.
Pre-regeneration validate:index rejects the known 2026-07-29T10:58:23.602Z / 2026-07-28T11:37:25.935Z pair.
data/model-index.json catalogGeneratedAt exactly equals data/models.json generatedAt after npm run generate:index.

Generated index excludes E1-E3 wrong mappings, includes gpt-5 effort matches selected by maximum score, and retains schemaVersion, board metadata/revisions, sourceModel/sourceUrl/match evidence, unmatched tracking, and openWeights.
package.json and both .github workflow files are not modified.
